subject: Startups
title: Secondary Sales
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Secondary Sales.

hook.text: SpaceX employees couldn't sell shares for years. Then secondary markets emerged, letting them cash out early.

buildup.text: Secondary sales let shareholders sell to private buyers before an IPO or acquisition.

discovery.text: Founders and early employees use secondaries to take money off the table, reducing personal financial pressure.

twist.text: Some investors oppose secondaries. They argue it reduces founder motivation if they've already gotten rich.

climax.text: Secondary markets have grown to $100 billion+ annually. They've become a key part of the startup ecosystem.

punchline.text: You don't have to wait for an IPO to get paid.

quiz.question: What are secondary sales in the startup context?
options: Shareholders selling equity before an IPO
A company's second round of funding
